Pastebin usage guide

Pastebin is a tool for quickly sharing code snippets, logs, or unformatted text.

1. Paste text or code

Copy the text or programming code you want and paste it into the input area.

2. Save and share link

Paina Tallenna ja luo linkki. The service saves the text and creates a short URL that you can copy to your clipboard.

3. Reading text

When the recipient opens the link, the text is displayed in a clean viewing interface with syntax highlighting. The recipient can copy all the content with one button.
